tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Parent: white. Kid: deep navy, carried from v1 so the app reads as a game, not homework.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Page wash outside the 480px app column; menu fills.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs, the hero. The ground most text sits on.

tokens.name: panel-alt
tokens.usage: Selected tiles and options, chips, the day-picker buttons. Purple-tinted on the parent surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and control outlines. Decorative only: 1.19:1 on panel (parent), 1.71:1 (kid) — below the 3:1 a control border needs, so never rely on it alone to show a control's edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, panel and panel-alt. Parent 16.41:1 on panel; kid 13.18:1.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy and ideas on panel. Parent 7.53:1; kid 10.07:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, field labels on panel and panel-alt. Parent 5.98:1 on panel (replaced the failing #8b95a7); kid 7.70:1.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected state, eyebrows. Text on panel: parent 7.03:1, kid 7.14:1. Lightened on the kid surface.

tokens.name: purple-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of purple. Parent 10.87:1 on white; kid 6.39:1.

tokens.name: purple-light
tokens.usage: Tint fill for cards, chips and selected rows. Never text, at any size.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Achievement only: the streak number, rank chip, progress bar, a won perfect day, a past-day outline. Never buttons or body copy. Parent 3.19:1 on panel — large text (24px+) and icons only; 2.90:1 on panel-alt fails. Kid 9.52:1.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold-colored text under 24px: points badges, perfect-day copy, attention pills. Parent 5.02:1 on panel, 4.58:1 on panel-alt; kid 9.52:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success: streak alive, activity done, the toast, a checked box. Kid 8.57:1 on panel. Parent 3.77:1 on panel and 3.44:1 on panel-alt — large text and icons only there; use green-text for smaller text.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green text under 24px on the parent surface (focus tips, celebrate pills). Parent 5.00:1 on panel-alt; kid 6.87:1.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Streak broken, destructive confirm, errors. Never decorative. Parent 4.83:1 on panel; kid 4.75:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Informational accents. Parent 5.17:1 on bg; kid 8.30:1.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a purple or green fill. On purple: parent 7.03:1, kid 9.42:1. On green: parent 3.77:1 (fails for 14px text — see checkbox), kid 11.32:1.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: The streak your kid won't want to break.
styles.usage: Marketing headline: the landing page's hero, once per page, never in the app. Fluid: clamp(var(--t-display), 7vw, var(--t-hero)) — 40px on phones, 64px on wide screens.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The largest heading inside the app. On the marketing site, section titles grow up to it, and the hero shrinks to it on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading. The app sets h2 at 800 (the spec says 700; code wins).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Play your groove for two minutes without stopping.
styles.usage: Default body. The floor for anything a kid reads; never smaller for parents.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense parent tables and secondary lines. Not for kids.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels and metadata. The kid surface raises it to 14px.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chips only, never a sentence. The kid surface raises it to 12px.

styles.name: streak
styles.usage: The streak number in the hero, in gold, tabular figures.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: chip icon to label, label to field.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Tile grid gap, small padding.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between stacked items; control padding.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; screen bottom padding.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Section rhythm.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Large separation.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Hero-scale separation.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, icon-picker cells, menu rows.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, option cards, activity tiles, modules.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: The hero card.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, progress bars, segmented buttons, toggles.

tokens.name: e-1
tokens.usage: Card at rest; the toggle knob.

tokens.name: e-2
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered card.

tokens.name: e-3
tokens.usage: Toasts and modals.

typeScale.note: The app reads these as --t-* custom properties. The kid surface raises t-caption to 14px and t-micro to 12px (set in components/bundle.css, since a size can't vary by theme here).

tokens.name: t-hero
tokens.usage: Size of the hero style at its largest; the marketing headline's cap.

tokens.name: t-display
tokens.usage: Size of the display style.

tokens.name: t-h1
tokens.usage: Size of h1.

tokens.name: t-h2
tokens.usage: Size of h2.

tokens.name: t-h3
tokens.usage: Size of h3.

tokens.name: t-body
tokens.usage: Size of body; the kid floor.

tokens.name: t-body-sm
tokens.usage: Size of body-sm.

tokens.name: t-caption
tokens.usage: Size of caption (14px on the kid surface).

tokens.name: t-micro
tokens.usage: Size of micro (12px on the kid surface).
